title: Lineout Lift Straight And True (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 132bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl mandolin harmonica
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the lineout is precision and trust
Throw it straight, lift it high, catch it clean
Numbers and codes, son, the lineout machine

[Verse 1]
Hooker throws the ball straight down the middle
Between the two lines, never a riddle
Flat trajectory, fast spin, target the jumper
The ball must travel five metres minimum, no fumble

[Pre-Chorus]
The lifter binds the shorts of the jumper
Hands under the thighs, lift on the call
Drive up through the legs, lock the arms
Jumper extends, catches at the peak, no harms

[Chorus]
Lineout lift straight and true, son
Throw flat, lift high, catch clean run
Two lifters, one jumper, three as one
Hooker throws the seam, the work is done

[Verse 2]
Front ball, middle ball, back ball, three options
Calls in code, bird names, coloured options
The other team listens, the calls must change
New call every match, never in range

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the lineout wins games
Quick ball off the top to the back line in flames
Maul off the catch, drive forward five metres
Two set piece options, the lineout meters

[Chorus]
Lineout lift straight and true, son
Throw flat, lift high, catch clean run
Two lifters, one jumper, three as one
Hooker throws the seam, the work is done

[Outro]
Throw flat, lift high, catch clean
Front, middle, back, three options seen
Codes change every match
Thats my boy, perfect catch
